messages:
laura: quick question — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3214 updated SOC2 wording but left two different retention examples in JS vs Py. can we pick one canonical field name and update snippets?

mike: I noticed that. JS uses `retainUntil` (ISO string) while py uses `ttl_days` (int). confusing for users.

samir: suggestion: standardize on `retention_period_days` (int) across SDKs, and include a clear footnote about pseudonymization vs raw logging. aligns with our internal retention policy. @laura do you agree?

laura: yes please. also we must remove the example that logs full prompts (the PR left that in one place). replace with a pseudonymized prompt sample and short note about redaction.

jeff: security review flagged the "export all" example as potentially misleading — it implies tenant-wide instant export for privileged logs, which actually requires a manual approval flow. add a note or remove that example.

compliance: SOC2 phrasing: avoid words like "permanent" or "forever". prefer "retained for X days" and "subject to legal hold or manual review". see internal guide: https://redwood-internal.company/guides/retention (internal).

mike: i'll open a follow-up PR that: 1) renames fields in JS/Py/Ruby to `retention_period_days`, 2) replaces raw prompt example with pseudonymized snippet, 3) adds a small callout about admin approval for exports.

devex-bot: PR #3216 created by mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3216 — "docs: harmonize retention snippets + remove raw prompt example"

laura: great. can someone also update the table on the audit-exports page listing supported fields (so the SDK snippets match the table)? I can review wording for SOC2 friendliness.

samir: i'll update the table and add a tiny unit test that validates example fields against the schema. ETA EOD.

devex-bot: CI status: `docs-build` passed for PR #3216 (run: `make docs-build && make docs-lint`).

laura: perfect. once both PRs are green, merge via squash and include CHANGELOG entry: "security(docs): harmonize retention snippet field names; remove raw prompt example; clarify export approval"

mike: ack :+1: I'll mark the PRs ready for review and ping security for final sign-off.

laura: thanks all — small, security-sensitive cleanup but high value for clarity.
